description: This is a unit test class for the LeaveEntitlementAPI within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system, specifically testing API endpoints related to leave entitlement functionalities.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the LeaveEntitlementAPI endpoints for retrieving leave entitlement data, extending endpoint integration test utilities.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' method of the LeaveEntitlementAPI to retrieve multiple leave entitlement records based on provided test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test data for testing the 'getAll' API endpoint, fetching test cases from a YAML configuration.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' method of the LeaveEntitlementAPI for retrieving a single leave entitlement record.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test data for testing the 'getOne' API endpoint, deriving test cases from a YAML configuration.
